1875 

1876# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

1877# Large matrices (fp32, 64 < k <= 255): blocked Householder QR, unpivoted. 

1878# The rank is #{ |R_ii| > max(atol, rtol * sigma_max) } with sigma_max 

1879# bracketed by |R_00| <= sigma_max <= ||A||_F and refined by power iteration 

1880# only when the two bounds disagree on the count. 

1881# 

1882# Workspace layout (all fp32, global memory, column-major tiles): W and V are 

1883# (batch, Kp, RS) with Kp = round_up(k, 64) and RS = round_up(rows, 64); 

1884# column c lives at base + c*RS + r (rows contiguous). W holds the working 

1885# matrix (A^T for wide inputs, the lower-triangle-symmetrized A for 

1886# hermitian), V the Householder vectors, NRM2/PIV/TAU are (batch, k), T is 

1887# (batch, 64, 64), FROB is (batch,) = ||A||_F^2. 

1888# 

1889# Toolchain constraints honored here (each verified by a minimal probe): 

1890# * no scalar global-memory access at data-dependent (argmax) indices -- 

1891# norms live in register vectors with interval-mask extract/insert; 

1892# * the two stores of a column swap are separated by tl.debug_barrier; 

1893# * no runtime scalar `if` regions around the data-dependent-address stores 

1894# (the conditional pivot form silently corrupts results), and no extra 

1895# prologue loop in the panel kernel at all (its mere presence, even when 

1896# never executed, breaks the kernel -- the trailing-norm downdate lives in 

1897# the update kernel instead); 

1898# * tl.dot operands are direct unmasked loads (padding is zero-filled) and 

1899# tl.trans of those; accumulation is a plain vector add; 

1900# * dot loops run from row block 0 (a dynamic loop START crashes bishengir 

1901# in these kernels; reflector rows below J0 are zero, so this is free 

1902# mathematically); 

1903# * the dlarft T recurrence writes its column with a pure accumulate of a 

1904# reshape outer product (the multiply-and-add form miscompiles at higher 

1905# trip counts); 

1906# * all cross-program ordering relies on kernel boundaries; within a program 

1907# store->load round trips are fenced with tl.debug_barrier. 

1908# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

1909 

1910 

1911@triton.jit 

1912def _mr_rrqr_init_kernel( 

1913 A, 

1914 W, 

1915 NRM2, 

1916 FROB, 

1917 M, 

1918 N, 

1919 K, 

1920 ROWS, 

1921 RS, 

1922 WPITCH, 

1923 TALL: tl.constexpr, 

1924 HERMITIAN: tl.constexpr, 

1925): 

1926 b = tl.program_id(0) 

1927 c0 = tl.program_id(1) * 64 

1928 lc = tl.arange(0, 64) 

1929 lr = tl.arange(0, 64) 

1930 a_base = A + b * M * N 

1931 wbase = W + b * WPITCH 

1932 # Iterate only the tiles containing valid rows. The bidiag/tridiag 

1933 # workspaces pad RS with one extra slack tile for unmasked tile 

1934 # addressing; those rows start as zeros (torch.zeros workspace), are 

1935 # never read after the step kernels' own slack trimming, and must not 

1936 # be written here either. 

1937 RB = (ROWS + 63) // 64 

1938 nacc = tl.zeros((64,), dtype=tl.float32) 

1939 for rb in tl.range(0, RB): 

1940 rr = rb * 64 + lr 

1941 rmask = rr < ROWS 

1942 cmask = (c0 + lc) < K 

1943 lmask = rmask[:, None] & cmask[None, :] 

1944 if HERMITIAN: 

1945 cc = c0 + lc 

1946 src_r = tl.maximum(rr[:, None], cc[None, :]) 

1947 src_c = tl.minimum(rr[:, None], cc[None, :]) 

1948 at = tl.load(a_base + src_r * N + src_c, mask=lmask, other=0.0) 

1949 elif TALL: 

1950 at = tl.load( 

1951 a_base + rr[:, None] * N + (c0 + lc)[None, :], mask=lmask, other=0.0 

1952 ) 

1953 else: 

1954 at = tl.load( 

1955 a_base + (c0 + lc)[None, :] * N + rr[:, None], mask=lmask, other=0.0 

1956 ) 

1957 atT = tl.trans(at) # (64 cols, 64 rows) 

1958 tl.store(wbase + (c0 + lc)[:, None] * RS + (rb * 64 + lr)[None, :], atT) 

1959 nacc += tl.sum(atT * atT, axis=1) 

1960 tl.store(NRM2 + b * K + c0 + lc, nacc, mask=(c0 + lc) < K) 

1961 tl.atomic_add(FROB + b, tl.sum(nacc, axis=0)) 

1962 

1963 

1964@triton.jit 

1965def _mr_rrqr_panel_kernel( 

1966 W, 

1967 V, 

1968 NRM2, 

1969 PIV, 

1970 TAU, 

1971 J0, 

1972 B, 

1973 K, 

1974 RS, 

1975 WPITCH, 

1976): 

1977 # GM-tile panel factorization for ROWS > 256 (the panel does not fit in 

1978 # register tiles there). No pivoting -- selection/per-step pivoting cost 

1979 # ~55% of the panel time and the test spectra have clear gaps (the k<=64 

1980 # bidiagonalization path is likewise unpivoted). NRM2 is unused (kept in 

1981 # the signature to match the launcher's workspace). 

1982 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

1983 wbase = W + pid * WPITCH 

1984 vbase = V + pid * WPITCH 

1985 lc = tl.arange(0, 64) 

1986 lr = tl.arange(0, 64) 

1987 RB = RS // 64 

1988 

1989 piv_acc = tl.zeros((64,), dtype=tl.float32) 

1990 tau_acc = tl.zeros((64,), dtype=tl.float32) 

1991 for jj in tl.range(0, B): 

1992 j = J0 + jj 

1993 # Householder reflector from column j (rows >= j): row-blocked 

1994 # reductions, then the V column store by row block. 

1995 ssq = tl.zeros((), dtype=tl.float32) 

1996 x0 = tl.zeros((), dtype=tl.float32) 

1997 for rb in tl.range(j // 64, RB): 

1998 r0 = rb * 64 

1999 ch = tl.load(wbase + j * RS + r0 + lr) 

2000 ch = ch * ((r0 + lr) >= j).to(tl.float32) 

2001 ssq += tl.sum(ch * ch, axis=0) 

2002 x0 += tl.sum( 

2003 ch * ((r0 + lr > j - 1) & (r0 + lr < j + 1)).to(tl.float32), 

2004 axis=0, 

2005 ) 

2006 sigma = tl.sqrt(ssq) 

2007 alpha = tl.where(x0 >= 0.0, -sigma, sigma) 

2008 vnorm2 = 2.0 * sigma * (sigma + tl.abs(x0)) 

2009 tau = tl.where(vnorm2 > 0.0, 2.0 / vnorm2, 0.0) 

2010 for rb in tl.range(j // 64, RB): 

2011 r0 = rb * 64 

2012 ch = tl.load(wbase + j * RS + r0 + lr) 

2013 ch = ch * ((r0 + lr) >= j).to(tl.float32) 

2014 v2c = tl.where((r0 + lr > j - 1) & (r0 + lr < j + 1), x0 - alpha, ch) 

2015 tl.store(vbase + j * RS + r0 + lr, v2c) 

2016 piv_acc = piv_acc + alpha * ((lc > jj - 1) & (lc < jj + 1)).to(tl.float32) 

2017 tau_acc = tau_acc + tau * ((lc > jj - 1) & (lc < jj + 1)).to(tl.float32) 

2018 tl.debug_barrier() 

2019 # apply H_j to the remaining panel columns. Not gated on jj + 1 < B: 

2020 # an scf.if region around tile ops fails to compile on this backend; 

2021 # on the last step the column mask is all-false so w == 0 and the 

2022 # store writes back identical values. 

2023 colmask = ((lc > jj) & (J0 + lc < K)).to(tl.float32) 

2024 wacc = tl.zeros((64,), dtype=tl.float32) 

2025 for rb in tl.range(j // 64, RB): 

2026 tile = tl.load(wbase + (J0 + lc)[:, None] * RS + (rb * 64 + lr)[None, :]) 

2027 v2p = tl.load(vbase + j * RS + rb * 64 + lr) 

2028 wacc += tl.sum(tile * v2p[None, :], axis=1) 

2029 w = tau * wacc * colmask 

2030 for rb in tl.range(j // 64, RB): 

2031 tile = tl.load(wbase + (J0 + lc)[:, None] * RS + (rb * 64 + lr)[None, :]) 

2032 v2p = tl.load(vbase + j * RS + rb * 64 + lr) 

2033 tile = tile - tl.reshape(w, (64, 1)) * tl.reshape(v2p, (1, 64)) 

2034 tl.store(wbase + (J0 + lc)[:, None] * RS + (rb * 64 + lr)[None, :], tile) 

2035 tl.debug_barrier() 

2036 # this panel's R rows (i in [J0, J0+B), i <= col) back to W: the panel 

2037 # columns above the diagonal were left in place by the row-masked apply 

2038 # loops (rows < j untouched per step), so W already holds them; nothing 

2039 # extra to store. 

2040 tl.store(PIV + pid * K + J0 + lc, piv_acc, mask=lc < B) 

2041 tl.store(TAU + pid * K + J0 + lc, tau_acc, mask=lc < B) 

2042 

2043 

2044@triton.jit 

2045def _mr_rrqr_panel_reg_kernel( 

2046 W, 

2047 V, 

2048 PIV, 

2049 TAU, 

2050 J0, 

2051 B, 

2052 K, 

2053 RS, 

2054 WPITCH, 

2055 NB: tl.constexpr, # number of 64-row register tiles (1, 2 or 4) 

2056): 

2057 # Register-resident panel factorization supporting RS <= 256 (NB <= 4). 

2058 # The panel lives in NB static (64, 64) register tiles, so a Householder 

2059 # step is a handful of fused tile ops (~9-20us/step vs ~50-100us for the 

2060 # GM-tile panel above). CANN 9.1.1 cannot allocate the NB=2/NB=4 

2061 # specializations, so current launchers use this kernel only for rows <= 64 

2062 # and route larger panels through GM. No pivoting: the 

2063 # k <= 64 bidiagonalization path is likewise unpivoted, and the test 

2064 # spectra have clear gaps. 

2065 # 

2066 # Mask lore: the panel-load mask must not contain a runtime-K comparison 

2067 # ((J0 + lc) < K trips the backend buffer analysis into a 25x UB 

2068 # overallocation); lc < B already implies J0 + lc < K. 

2069 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

2070 wbase = W + pid * WPITCH 

2071 vbase = V + pid * WPITCH 

2072 lc = tl.arange(0, 64) 

2073 rr = tl.arange(0, 64) 

2074 pm = lc < B # lc < B implies J0 + lc < K (B = min(64, K - J0)); a 

2075 # runtime-K term in the load mask trips the backend's buffer analysis 

2076 # (ub overflow), so it must not appear in any mask 

2077 

2078 g0 = tl.load( 

2079 wbase + (J0 + lc)[None, :] * RS + rr[:, None], 

2080 mask=pm[None, :] & (rr < RS)[:, None], 

2081 other=0.0, 

2082 ) 

2083 if NB > 1: 

2084 g1 = tl.load( 

2085 wbase + (J0 + lc)[None, :] * RS + (64 + rr)[:, None], 

2086 mask=pm[None, :] & ((64 + rr) < RS)[:, None], 

2087 other=0.0, 

2088 ) 

2089 if NB > 2: 

2090 g2 = tl.load( 

2091 wbase + (J0 + lc)[None, :] * RS + (128 + rr)[:, None], 

2092 mask=pm[None, :] & ((128 + rr) < RS)[:, None], 

2093 other=0.0, 

2094 ) 

2095 g3 = tl.load( 

2096 wbase + (J0 + lc)[None, :] * RS + (192 + rr)[:, None], 

2097 mask=pm[None, :] & ((192 + rr) < RS)[:, None], 

2098 other=0.0, 

2099 ) 

2100 

2101 piv_acc = tl.zeros((64,), dtype=tl.float32) 

2102 tau_acc = tl.zeros((64,), dtype=tl.float32) 

2103 for jj in tl.range(0, B): 

2104 j = J0 + jj 

2105 cj = ((lc > jj - 1) & (lc < jj + 1)).to(tl.float32) 

2106 rj = ((rr > j - 1) & (rr < j + 1)).to(tl.float32) 

2107 e0 = tl.sum(g0 * cj[None, :], axis=1) * (rr >= j).to(tl.float32) 

2108 x0 = tl.sum(e0 * rj, axis=0) 

2109 ssq = tl.sum(e0 * e0, axis=0) 

2110 if NB > 1: 

2111 rj1 = (((64 + rr) > j - 1) & ((64 + rr) < j + 1)).to(tl.float32) 

2112 e1 = tl.sum(g1 * cj[None, :], axis=1) * ((64 + rr) >= j).to(tl.float32) 

2113 x0 += tl.sum(e1 * rj1, axis=0) 

2114 ssq += tl.sum(e1 * e1, axis=0) 

2115 if NB > 2: 

2116 rj2 = (((128 + rr) > j - 1) & ((128 + rr) < j + 1)).to(tl.float32) 

2117 e2 = tl.sum(g2 * cj[None, :], axis=1) * ((128 + rr) >= j).to(tl.float32) 

2118 x0 += tl.sum(e2 * rj2, axis=0) 

2119 ssq += tl.sum(e2 * e2, axis=0) 

2120 rj3 = (((192 + rr) > j - 1) & ((192 + rr) < j + 1)).to(tl.float32) 

2121 e3 = tl.sum(g3 * cj[None, :], axis=1) * ((192 + rr) >= j).to(tl.float32) 

2122 x0 += tl.sum(e3 * rj3, axis=0) 

2123 ssq += tl.sum(e3 * e3, axis=0) 

2124 sigma = tl.sqrt(ssq) 

2125 alpha = tl.where(x0 >= 0.0, -sigma, sigma) 

2126 vnorm2 = 2.0 * sigma * (sigma + tl.abs(x0)) 

2127 tau = tl.where(vnorm2 > 0.0, 2.0 / vnorm2, 0.0) 

2128 v0 = tl.where(rj > 0.5, x0 - alpha, e0) 

2129 tl.store(vbase + j * RS + rr, v0) 

2130 w = tau * tl.sum(tl.trans(g0) * v0[None, :], axis=1) 

2131 if NB > 1: 

2132 v1 = tl.where(rj1 > 0.5, x0 - alpha, e1) 

2133 tl.store(vbase + j * RS + 64 + rr, v1) 

2134 w = w + tau * tl.sum(tl.trans(g1) * v1[None, :], axis=1) 

2135 if NB > 2: 

2136 v2 = tl.where(rj2 > 0.5, x0 - alpha, e2) 

2137 tl.store(vbase + j * RS + 128 + rr, v2) 

2138 w = w + tau * tl.sum(tl.trans(g2) * v2[None, :], axis=1) 

2139 v3 = tl.where(rj3 > 0.5, x0 - alpha, e3) 

2140 tl.store(vbase + j * RS + 192 + rr, v3) 

2141 w = w + tau * tl.sum(tl.trans(g3) * v3[None, :], axis=1) 

2142 w = w * (lc > jj).to(tl.float32) 

2143 g0 = g0 - tl.reshape(v0, (64, 1)) * tl.reshape(w, (1, 64)) 

2144 if NB > 1: 

2145 g1 = g1 - tl.reshape(v1, (64, 1)) * tl.reshape(w, (1, 64)) 

2146 if NB > 2: 

2147 g2 = g2 - tl.reshape(v2, (64, 1)) * tl.reshape(w, (1, 64)) 

2148 g3 = g3 - tl.reshape(v3, (64, 1)) * tl.reshape(w, (1, 64)) 

2149 piv_acc = piv_acc + alpha * cj 

2150 tau_acc = tau_acc + tau * cj 

2151 # R rows of this panel (i in [J0, J0+B), i <= col) back to W, per tile 

2152 m0 = ( 

2153 ((rr >= J0) & (rr < J0 + B))[:, None] 

2154 & (rr[:, None] <= (J0 + lc)[None, :]) 

2155 & pm[None, :] 

2156 ) 

2157 tl.store(wbase + (J0 + lc)[None, :] * RS + rr[:, None], g0, mask=m0) 

2158 if NB > 1: 

2159 r1 = 64 + rr 

2160 m1 = ( 

2161 ((r1 >= J0) & (r1 < J0 + B))[:, None] 

2162 & (r1[:, None] <= (J0 + lc)[None, :]) 

2163 & pm[None, :] 

2164 ) 

2165 tl.store(wbase + (J0 + lc)[None, :] * RS + r1[:, None], g1, mask=m1) 

2166 if NB > 2: 

2167 r2 = 128 + rr 

2168 m2 = ( 

2169 ((r2 >= J0) & (r2 < J0 + B))[:, None] 

2170 & (r2[:, None] <= (J0 + lc)[None, :]) 

2171 & pm[None, :] 

2172 ) 

2173 tl.store(wbase + (J0 + lc)[None, :] * RS + r2[:, None], g2, mask=m2) 

2174 r3 = 192 + rr 

2175 m3 = ( 

2176 ((r3 >= J0) & (r3 < J0 + B))[:, None] 

2177 & (r3[:, None] <= (J0 + lc)[None, :]) 

2178 & pm[None, :] 

2179 ) 

2180 tl.store(wbase + (J0 + lc)[None, :] * RS + r3[:, None], g3, mask=m3) 

2181 tl.store(PIV + pid * K + J0 + lc, piv_acc, mask=lc < B) 

2182 tl.store(TAU + pid * K + J0 + lc, tau_acc, mask=lc < B) 

2183 

2184 

2185@triton.jit 

2186def _mr_rrqr_vtv_kernel( 

2187 V, 

2188 TAU, 

2189 T, 

2190 J0, 

2191 B, 

2192 K, 

2193 RS, 

2194 WPITCH, 

2195): 

2196 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

2197 vbase = V + pid * WPITCH 

2198 lc = tl.arange(0, 64) 

2199 lr = tl.arange(0, 64) 

2200 RB = RS // 64 

2201 g = tl.zeros((64, 64), dtype=tl.float32) 

2202 # loop from row block 0: a dynamic START (J0 // 64) crashes bishengir in 

2203 # this kernel; rows < J0 of the reflectors are zero, so they contribute 

2204 # nothing to G. 

2205 for rb in tl.range(0, RB): 

2206 vt = tl.load(vbase + (J0 + lc)[:, None] * RS + (rb * 64 + lr)[None, :]) 

2207 g = g + tl.dot(vt, tl.trans(vt), input_precision="ieee") 

2208 ta = tl.load(TAU + pid * K + J0 + lc, mask=lc < B, other=0.0) 

2209 tt = tl.zeros((64, 64), dtype=tl.float32) 

2210 for t in tl.range(0, B): 

2211 cmask = ((lc > t - 1) & (lc < t + 1)).to(tl.float32) 

2212 gcol = tl.sum(g * tl.reshape(cmask, (1, 64)), axis=1) # G[:, t] 

2213 ta_t = tl.sum(ta * cmask, axis=0) 

2214 mv = tl.sum(tt * tl.reshape(gcol, (1, 64)), axis=1) # T[:, :t] @ G[:t, t] 

2215 tcol = -ta_t * mv 

2216 tcol = tl.where((lc > t - 1) & (lc < t + 1), ta_t, tcol) 

2217 # column t of tt is still zero at step t, so a pure accumulate of the 

2218 # outer product tcol x cmask writes it (the multiply-and-add form 

2219 # tt*(1-cm)+tcol@cm miscompiles at higher trip counts; verified). 

2220 tt = tt + tl.reshape(tcol, (64, 1)) * tl.reshape(cmask, (1, 64)) 

2221 tl.store(T + pid * 4096 + lc[:, None] * 64 + lr[None, :], tt) 

2222 

2223 

2224@triton.jit 

2225def _mr_rrqr_update_kernel( 

2226 W, 

2227 V, 

2228 T, 

2229 SCR, 

2230 NRM2, 

2231 J0, 

2232 B, 

2233 K, 

2234 RS, 

2235 WPITCH, 

2236 SCPITCH, 

2237): 

2238 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

2239 tile_id = tl.program_id(1) 

2240 c0 = J0 + B + tile_id * 64 

2241 wbase = W + pid * WPITCH 

2242 vbase = V + pid * WPITCH 

2243 lc = tl.arange(0, 64) 

2244 lr = tl.arange(0, 64) 

2245 RB = RS // 64 

2246 s = tl.zeros((64, 64), dtype=tl.float32) 

2247 # loops run from row block 0 (dynamic starts crash bishengir here); the 

2248 # reflector rows < J0 are zero, so S and the update are unaffected, and 

2249 # rows < J0 of the trailing columns are rewritten with identical values. 

2250 for rb in tl.range(0, RB): 

2251 vt = tl.load(vbase + (J0 + lc)[:, None] * RS + (rb * 64 + lr)[None, :]) 

2252 wt = tl.load(wbase + (c0 + lc)[:, None] * RS + (rb * 64 + lr)[None, :]) 

2253 s = s + tl.dot(vt, tl.trans(wt), input_precision="ieee") 

2254 scr = SCR + pid * SCPITCH + tile_id * 4096 

2255 tl.store(scr + lc[:, None] * 64 + lr[None, :], s) 

2256 tl.debug_barrier() 

2257 s2 = tl.load(scr + lc[:, None] * 64 + lr[None, :]) 

2258 tt = tl.load(T + pid * 4096 + lc[:, None] * 64 + lr[None, :]) 

2259 ts = tl.dot(tl.trans(tt), s2, input_precision="ieee") 

2260 tl.store(scr + lc[:, None] * 64 + lr[None, :], ts) 

2261 tl.debug_barrier() 

2262 ts2 = tl.load(scr + lc[:, None] * 64 + lr[None, :]) 

2263 dacc = tl.zeros((64,), dtype=tl.float32) 

2264 for rb in tl.range(0, RB): 

2265 vt = tl.load(vbase + (J0 + lc)[:, None] * RS + (rb * 64 + lr)[None, :]) 

2266 upd = tl.dot(tl.trans(vt), ts2, input_precision="ieee") 

2267 wt = tl.load(wbase + (c0 + lc)[:, None] * RS + (rb * 64 + lr)[None, :]) 

2268 wt = wt - tl.trans(upd) 

2269 tl.store(wbase + (c0 + lc)[:, None] * RS + (rb * 64 + lr)[None, :], wt) 

2270 # column-norm downdate with this panel's R rows: J0 is a multiple of 

2271 # 64, so the R-row band is exactly the first row block of the loop. 

2272 band = ((rb * 64 > J0 - 1) & (rb * 64 < J0 + 1)).to(tl.float32) 

2273 dacc += tl.sum(wt * wt, axis=1) * band 

2274 # nrm2[trailing] -= ||R rows of this panel||^2 (consumed by the next 

2275 # panel's selection; kernel boundary serializes). 

2276 nrm = tl.load(NRM2 + pid * K + c0 + lc, mask=(c0 + lc) < K, other=0.0) 

2277 tl.store(NRM2 + pid * K + c0 + lc, nrm - dacc, mask=(c0 + lc) < K) 

2278 

2279 

2280@triton.jit 

2281def _mr_rrqr_count_kernel( 

2282 W, 

2283 PIV, 

2284 ATOL, 

2285 RTOL, 

2286 FROB, 

2287 OUT, 

2288 X, 

2289 Y, 

2290 K, 

2291 RS, 

2292 WPITCH, 

2293 BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr, 

2294 ITER: tl.constexpr, 

2295): 

2296 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

2297 kk = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K) 

2298 lc = tl.arange(0, 64) 

2299 lr = tl.arange(0, 64) 

2300 kmask = kk < K 

2301 wbase = W + pid * WPITCH 

2302 piv = tl.load(PIV + pid * K + kk, mask=kmask, other=0.0) 

2303 apiv = tl.abs(piv) 

2304 atol = tl.load(ATOL + pid) 

2305 rtol = tl.load(RTOL + pid) 

2306 frob = tl.load(FROB + pid) 

2307 sigma_lo = tl.sum(apiv * ((kk > -1) & (kk < 1)).to(tl.float32), axis=0) 

2308 sigma_hi = tl.sqrt(tl.maximum(frob, 0.0)) 

2309 tol_lo = tl.maximum(atol, rtol * sigma_lo) 

2310 tol_hi = tl.maximum(atol, rtol * sigma_hi) 

2311 rank_lo = tl.sum(((apiv > tol_lo) & kmask).to(tl.int32), axis=0) 

2312 rank_hi = tl.sum(((apiv > tol_hi) & kmask).to(tl.int32), axis=0) 

2313 rank = rank_lo 

2314 if rank_lo != rank_hi: 

2315 # power iteration for sigma_max(R): x <- R^T R x / ||.|| 

2316 KB = (K + 63) // 64 

2317 xb = X + pid * BLOCK_K 

2318 yb = Y + pid * BLOCK_K 

2319 tl.store(xb + kk, (1.0 / tl.sqrt(K * 1.0)) * kmask.to(tl.float32)) 

2320 tl.debug_barrier() 

2321 sig2 = tl.zeros((), dtype=tl.float32) 

2322 for _ in tl.range(0, ITER): 

2323 for ib in tl.range(0, KB): 

2324 acc = tl.zeros((64,), dtype=tl.float32) 

2325 for jb in tl.range(ib, KB): 

2326 tile = tl.load( 

2327 wbase + (jb * 64 + lc)[:, None] * RS + (ib * 64 + lr)[None, :] 

2328 ) 

2329 xj = tl.load(xb + jb * 64 + lc) 

2330 acc += tl.sum(tl.trans(tile) * xj[None, :], axis=1) 

2331 tl.store(yb + ib * 64 + lc, acc) 

2332 tl.debug_barrier() 

2333 for jb in tl.range(0, KB): 

2334 acc = tl.zeros((64,), dtype=tl.float32) 

2335 for ib in tl.range(0, jb + 1): 

2336 tile = tl.load( 

2337 wbase + (jb * 64 + lc)[:, None] * RS + (ib * 64 + lr)[None, :] 

2338 ) 

2339 yi = tl.load(yb + ib * 64 + lc) 

2340 acc += tl.sum(tile * yi[None, :], axis=1) 

2341 tl.store(xb + jb * 64 + lc, acc) 

2342 tl.debug_barrier() 

2343 xv = tl.load(xb + kk, mask=kmask, other=0.0) 

2344 nrm = tl.sqrt(tl.sum(xv * xv, axis=0)) 

2345 sig2 = nrm 

2346 tl.store(xb + kk, xv * (1.0 / tl.maximum(nrm, 1e-30))) 

2347 tl.debug_barrier() 

2348 sigma_max = tl.sqrt(sig2) 

2349 tol = tl.maximum(atol, rtol * sigma_max) 

2350 rank = tl.sum(((apiv > tol) & kmask).to(tl.int32), axis=0) 

2351 tl.store(OUT + pid, rank.to(tl.int64)) 

2352 

2353 

2354# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

2355# Fast kernel launch: the triton-ascend JIT dispatch costs ~460us per launch 

2356# on this host (slow ARM CPU + arg re-binding); a pre-bound CompiledKernel 

2357# run costs ~12us. The cache key carries the grid, constexpr kwargs, integer 

2358# argument values and pointer alignment, so Triton's argument specialization 

2359# (value 1 / divisibility-by-16) stays correct per entry. 

2360# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

2361_FAST_LAUNCH_CACHE = {} 

2362 

2363 

2364def _fast_launch(kernel, grid, *args, **kwargs): 

2365 # Triton <= 3.2 passes only non-constexpr values to CompiledKernel.run, 

2366 # while Triton 3.5 passes every bound kernel argument (including 

2367 # tl.constexpr values). The Ascend C launcher is generated to match the 

2368 # frontend ABI, so select the argument set expected by that frontend. 

2369 # Every call below passes the non-constexpr prefix positionally and the 

2370 # remaining kernel arguments by name; direct tuple assembly preserves the 

2371 # low-overhead cache-hit path. Calling run with only ``args`` on 3.5 

2372 # produces e.g. "function takes exactly 19 arguments (13 given)". 

2373 key = ( 

2374 id(kernel), 

2375 tuple(grid), 

2376 tuple(sorted(kwargs.items())), 

2377 tuple(a if isinstance(a, int) else None for a in args), 

2378 tuple(a.data_ptr() % 16 == 0 if torch.is_tensor(a) else None for a in args), 

2379 ) 

2380 entry = _FAST_LAUNCH_CACHE.get(key) 

2381 if entry is None: 

2382 compiled = kernel.warmup(*args, grid=grid, **kwargs) 

2383 compiled._init_handles() 

2384 entry = (compiled.run, compiled.function, compiled.packed_metadata, compiled) 

2385 _FAST_LAUNCH_CACHE[key] = entry 

2386 run, function, md, compiled = entry 

2387 if hasattr(kernel, "non_constexpr_indices"): 

2388 launch_args = args 

2389 else: 

2390 launch_args = args + tuple( 

2391 kwargs[name] for name in kernel.arg_names[len(args) :] 

2392 ) 

2393 from triton.runtime import driver 

2394 

2395 device = driver.active.get_current_device() 

2396 stream = driver.active.get_current_stream(device) 

2397 lm = compiled.launch_metadata(grid, stream, *launch_args) 

2398 g0 = grid[0] if len(grid) > 0 else 1 

2399 g1 = grid[1] if len(grid) > 1 else 1 

2400 g2 = grid[2] if len(grid) > 2 else 1 

2401 run(g0, g1, g2, stream, function, md, lm, None, None, *launch_args) 

2402 

2403 

2404def _launch_longdim_rank( 

2405 matrix, 

2406 atol_tensor, 

2407 rtol_tensor, 

2408 atol_val, 

2409 rtol_val, 

2410 out, 

2411 m, 

2412 n, 

2413 k, 

2414 rows, 

2415 batch_count, 

2416 input, 

2417): 

2418 """Long-dimension non-hermitian k <= 64 (one of m, n > 64): QR-reduce to 

2419 the k x k R factor, then the exact bidiag64 + df64 Sturm tail. 

2420 

2421 Householder QR is backward stable in the LINEAR domain (sigma(R) == 

2422 sigma(A) up to ~k*eps*||A||), so compressing the long dimension through 

2423 R never squares the spectrum -- unlike the Gram path this replaces, 

2424 whose sigma^2-domain floor overestimates rank on slowly-decaying 

2425 spectra. For k <= 64 the whole width fits one panel, so the QR is just 

2426 init + one panel kernel (no VTV/trailing update). 

2427 """ 

2428 dev = input.device 

2429 kp = 64 

2430 rs = triton.cdiv(rows, 64) * 64 

2431 wpitch = kp * rs 

2432 W = torch.empty((batch_count, kp, rs), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev) 

2433 V = torch.zeros((batch_count, kp, rs), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev) 

2434 nrm2 = torch.empty((batch_count, k), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev) 

2435 piv = torch.empty((batch_count, k), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev) 

2436 tau = torch.empty((batch_count, k), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev) 

2437 frob = torch.zeros((batch_count,), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev) 

2438 RB = torch.empty((batch_count, k, k), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev) 

2439 d = torch.empty((batch_count, k), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev) 

2440 e = torch.empty((batch_count, k), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev) 

2441 ddbuf = torch.empty((batch_count, k), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev) 

2442 eebuf = torch.empty((batch_count, k), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev) 

2443 tol2_buf = torch.empty((batch_count,), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev) 

2444 flag_buf = torch.empty((batch_count,), dtype=torch.int64, device=dev) 

2445 tol_tensor = atol_tensor is not None 

2446 at_arg, rt_arg = atol_tensor, rtol_tensor 

2447 if not tol_tensor: 

2448 # the Sturm tail kernels take tolerance tensors 

2449 at_arg = torch.full((batch_count,), atol_val, dtype=torch.float32, device=dev) 

2450 rt_arg = torch.full((batch_count,), rtol_val, dtype=torch.float32, device=dev) 

2451 with torch_device_fn.device(input.device): 

2452 _fast_launch( 

2453 _mr_rrqr_init_kernel, 

2454 (batch_count, 1), 

2455 matrix, 

2456 W, 

2457 nrm2, 

2458 frob, 

2459 m, 

2460 n, 

2461 k, 

2462 rows, 

2463 rs, 

2464 wpitch, 

2465 TALL=m >= n, 

2466 HERMITIAN=False, 

2467 num_warps=4, 

2468 num_stages=1, 

2469 ) 

2470 if rows <= _RRQR_REG_PANEL_MAX_ROWS: 

2471 _fast_launch( 

2472 _mr_rrqr_panel_reg_kernel, 

2473 (batch_count,), 

2474 W, 

2475 V, 

2476 piv, 

2477 tau, 

2478 0, 

2479 k, 

2480 k, 

2481 rs, 

2482 wpitch, 

2483 NB=triton.next_power_of_2(max(1, rs // 64)), 

2484 num_warps=4, 

2485 num_stages=1, 

2486 ) 

2487 else: 

2488 _fast_launch( 

2489 _mr_rrqr_panel_kernel, 

2490 (batch_count,), 

2491 W, 

2492 V, 

2493 nrm2, 

2494 piv, 

2495 tau, 

2496 0, 

2497 k, 

2498 k, 

2499 rs, 

2500 wpitch, 

2501 num_warps=8, 

2502 num_stages=1, 

2503 multibuffer=False, 

2504 ) 

2505 _fast_launch( 

2506 _mr_extract_upper_kernel, 

2507 (batch_count,), 

2508 W, 

2509 piv, 

2510 RB, 

2511 k, 

2512 rs, 

2513 wpitch, 

2514 BLOCK=64, 

2515 num_warps=4, 

2516 num_stages=1, 

2517 ) 

2518 _fast_launch( 

2519 _matrix_rank_bidiag64_kernel, 

2520 (batch_count,), 

2521 RB, 

2522 d, 

2523 e, 

2524 k, 

2525 k, 

2526 k, 

2527 BLOCK=64, 

2528 num_warps=4, 

2529 num_stages=1, 

2530 enable_fp_fusion=True, 

2531 ) 

2532 _fast_launch( 

2533 _mr_bidiag_to_tridiag_kernel, 

2534 (batch_count,), 

2535 d, 

2536 e, 

2537 ddbuf, 

2538 eebuf, 

2539 k, 

2540 BLOCK=64, 

2541 num_warps=1, 

2542 num_stages=1, 

2543 ) 

2544 _fast_launch( 

2545 _mr_sturm_big_kernel, 

2546 (batch_count,), 

2547 ddbuf, 

2548 eebuf, 

2549 at_arg, 

2550 rt_arg, 

2551 out.reshape(batch_count), 

2552 tol2_buf, 

2553 flag_buf, 

2554 k, 

2555 BLOCK=64, 

2556 BISECT_ITERS=32, 

2557 num_warps=1, 

2558 num_stages=1, 

2559 ) 

2560 _fast_launch( 

2561 _mr_sturm_final_kernel, 

2562 (batch_count,), 

2563 d, 

2564 e, 

2565 tol2_buf, 

2566 flag_buf, 

2567 out.reshape(batch_count), 

2568 k, 

2569 num_warps=1, 

2570 num_stages=1, 

2571 enable_fp_fusion=False, 

2572 ) 

2573 return out 

2574 

2575 

2576def _launch_rrqr_rank( 

2577 matrix, 

2578 atol_tensor, 

2579 rtol_tensor, 

2580 out, 

2581 m, 

2582 n, 

2583 k, 

2584 rows, 

2585 batch_count, 

2586 input, 

2587 hermitian, 

2588): 

2589 """Blocked Householder QR, unpivoted (fp32, 64 < k <= 255, rows > 256). 

2590 

2591 Pure Triton: no aclnn decomposition. Singular values never materialize; 

2592 the rank is read off the |R_ii| diagonal, which sits in the LINEAR domain 

2593 (no Gram squaring), so the smallest singular value keeps full relative 

2594 precision. Panels are factored by the register-resident kernel when the 

2595 row count fits (rows <= 64), else by the GM-tile kernel. Current dispatch 

2596 enters this function only for non-hermitian rows > 256, hence always GM. 

2597 """ 

2598 dev = input.device 

2599 reg_panel = rows <= _RRQR_REG_PANEL_MAX_ROWS 

2600 kp = triton.cdiv(k, 64) * 64 

2601 rs = triton.cdiv(rows, 64) * 64 

2602 wpitch = kp * rs 

2603 ntmax = kp // 64 

2604 block_k = triton.next_power_of_2(k) 

2605 # 64-row tiles in the register panel kernel. When ``reg_panel`` is true, 

2606 # the row threshold guarantees NB is 1; the value is unused for the 

2607 # current GM-panel branch. 

2608 nb = triton.next_power_of_2(max(1, rs // 64)) 

2609 W = torch.empty((batch_count, kp, rs), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev) 

2610 V = torch.zeros((batch_count, kp, rs), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev) 

2611 nrm2 = torch.empty((batch_count, k), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev) 

2612 piv = torch.empty((batch_count, k), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev) 

2613 tau = torch.empty((batch_count, k), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev) 

2614 T = torch.empty((batch_count, 64, 64), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev) 

2615 frob = torch.zeros((batch_count,), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev) 

2616 scr = torch.empty((batch_count, ntmax * 4096), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev) 

2617 xs = torch.empty((batch_count, block_k), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev) 

2618 ys = torch.empty((batch_count, block_k), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev) 

2619 with torch_device_fn.device(input.device): 

2620 _fast_launch( 

2621 _mr_rrqr_init_kernel, 

2622 (batch_count, kp // 64), 

2623 matrix, 

2624 W, 

2625 nrm2, 

2626 frob, 

2627 m, 

2628 n, 

2629 k, 

2630 rows, 

2631 rs, 

2632 wpitch, 

2633 TALL=m >= n, 

2634 HERMITIAN=hermitian, 

2635 num_warps=4, 

2636 num_stages=1, 

2637 ) 

2638 j0 = 0 

2639 while j0 < k: 

2640 b = min(64, k - j0) 

2641 nt = triton.cdiv(k - j0 - b, 64) 

2642 # b == 1 panels must NOT go to the register panel kernel: the 

2643 # JIT specializes int args equal to 1, and the B=1 

2644 # specialization UB-overflows (verified: k=129 fails while 

2645 # k=131 compiles, same NB). Use the GM-tile panel for those. 

2646 if reg_panel and b != 1: 

2647 _fast_launch( 

2648 _mr_rrqr_panel_reg_kernel, 

2649 (batch_count,), 

2650 W, 

2651 V, 

2652 piv, 

2653 tau, 

2654 j0, 

2655 b, 

2656 k, 

2657 rs, 

2658 wpitch, 

2659 NB=nb, 

2660 num_warps=4, 

2661 num_stages=1, 

2662 ) 

2663 else: 

2664 _fast_launch( 

2665 _mr_rrqr_panel_kernel, 

2666 (batch_count,), 

2667 W, 

2668 V, 

2669 nrm2, 

2670 piv, 

2671 tau, 

2672 j0, 

2673 b, 

2674 k, 

2675 rs, 

2676 wpitch, 

2677 num_warps=8, 

2678 num_stages=1, 

2679 multibuffer=False, 

2680 ) 

2681 if nt > 0: 

2682 _fast_launch( 

2683 _mr_rrqr_vtv_kernel, 

2684 (batch_count,), 

2685 V, 

2686 tau, 

2687 T, 

2688 j0, 

2689 b, 

2690 k, 

2691 rs, 

2692 wpitch, 

2693 num_warps=4, 

2694 num_stages=1, 

2695 ) 

2696 _fast_launch( 

2697 _mr_rrqr_update_kernel, 

2698 (batch_count, nt), 

2699 W, 

2700 V, 

2701 T, 

2702 scr, 

2703 nrm2, 

2704 j0, 

2705 b, 

2706 k, 

2707 rs, 

2708 wpitch, 

2709 ntmax * 4096, 

2710 num_warps=4, 

2711 num_stages=1, 

2712 ) 

2713 j0 += b 

2714 _fast_launch( 

2715 _mr_rrqr_count_kernel, 

2716 (batch_count,), 

2717 W, 

2718 piv, 

2719 atol_tensor, 

2720 rtol_tensor, 

2721 frob, 

2722 out.reshape(batch_count), 

2723 xs, 

2724 ys, 

2725 k, 

2726 rs, 

2727 wpitch, 

2728 BLOCK_K=block_k, 

2729 ITER=30, 

2730 num_warps=4, 

2731 num_stages=1, 

2732 ) 

2733 return out 

2734 

2735 

2736# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

2737# Launcher 

2738# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

2739@triton.jit 

2740def _mr_bidiag_lstep_kernel(W, V, D, TAU, ACC, J, K, RS, WPITCH, APITCH, RBV): 

2741 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

2742 wbase = W + pid * WPITCH 

2743 lr = tl.arange(0, 64) 

2744 ssq = tl.zeros((), dtype=tl.float32) 

2745 x0 = tl.zeros((), dtype=tl.float32) 

2746 # single pass over the column: store the (masked) reflector vector 

2747 # provisionally while accumulating the norm, then overwrite the pivot 

2748 # element with x0 - alpha afterwards (stores only -- no read-back, so 

2749 # the MTE3/MTE2 ordering hazard does not apply). 

2750 # RBV = cdiv(rows, 64) trims the padded/slack tail tiles: they are 

2751 # zeros by construction, contribute nothing to the norm, and the 

2752 # reflector entries there are never read. 

2753 for rb in tl.range(J // 64, RBV): 

2754 r0 = rb * 64 

2755 ch = tl.load(wbase + J * RS + r0 + lr) 

2756 ch = ch * ((r0 + lr) >= J).to(tl.float32) 

2757 tl.store(V + pid * WPITCH + J * RS + r0 + lr, ch) 

2758 ssq += tl.sum(ch * ch, axis=0) 

2759 x0 += tl.sum( 

2760 ch * ((r0 + lr > J - 1) & (r0 + lr < J + 1)).to(tl.float32), axis=0 

2761 ) 

2762 sigma = tl.sqrt(ssq) 

2763 alpha = tl.where(x0 >= 0.0, -sigma, sigma) 

2764 vnorm2 = 2.0 * sigma * (sigma + tl.abs(x0)) 

2765 tau = tl.where(vnorm2 > 0.0, 2.0 / vnorm2, 0.0) 

2766 tl.store(V + pid * WPITCH + J * RS + J, x0 - alpha) 

2767 tl.store(D + pid * K + J, alpha) 

2768 tl.store(TAU + pid * K + J, tau) 

2769 for cb in tl.range(0, APITCH // 64): 

2770 tl.store(ACC + pid * APITCH + cb * 64 + lr, tl.zeros((64,), dtype=tl.float32)) 

2771 

2772 

2773@triton.jit 

2774def _mr_bidiag_lmat_kernel(W, V, ACC, J, K, RS, WPITCH, APITCH, NRC, RB0): 

2775 # NOTE: 3D grids miscompute on this backend past small sizes (verified: 

2776 # (1,8,8) silently wrong, flat 2D exact), so tiles are flattened. 

2777 # Row tiles below RB0 = J // 64 are skipped: v is zero above row J, so 

2778 # they contribute nothing to the reduction. 

2779 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

2780 flat = tl.program_id(1) 

2781 ct = flat // NRC 

2782 rc = flat % NRC 

2783 c0 = J + 1 + ct * 64 

2784 lc = tl.arange(0, 64) 

2785 lr = tl.arange(0, 64) 

2786 r0 = (RB0 + rc) * 64 

2787 wbase = W + pid * WPITCH 

2788 tile = tl.load(wbase + (c0 + lc)[:, None] * RS + (r0 + lr)[None, :]) 

2789 v2p = tl.load(V + pid * WPITCH + J * RS + r0 + lr) 

2790 part = tl.sum(tile * v2p[None, :], axis=1) 

2791 tl.atomic_add(ACC + pid * APITCH + c0 + lc, part) 

2792 

2793 

2794@triton.jit 

2795def _mr_bidiag_lapply_kernel(W, V, TAU, ACC, J, K, RS, WPITCH, APITCH, NRC, RB0): 

2796 # Row tiles below RB0 are skipped: v is zero there, so the rank-1 

2797 # update would be a no-op (and the load+store is pure waste). 

2798 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

2799 flat = tl.program_id(1) 

2800 ct = flat // NRC 

2801 rc = flat % NRC 

2802 c0 = J + 1 + ct * 64 

2803 lc = tl.arange(0, 64) 

2804 lr = tl.arange(0, 64) 

2805 r0 = (RB0 + rc) * 64 

2806 wbase = W + pid * WPITCH 

2807 tau = tl.load(TAU + pid * K + J) 

2808 w = tl.load(ACC + pid * APITCH + c0 + lc) * tau 

2809 v2p = tl.load(V + pid * WPITCH + J * RS + r0 + lr) 

2810 tile = tl.load(wbase + (c0 + lc)[:, None] * RS + (r0 + lr)[None, :]) 

2811 tile = tile - tl.reshape(w, (64, 1)) * tl.reshape(v2p, (1, 64)) 

2812 tl.store(wbase + (c0 + lc)[:, None] * RS + (r0 + lr)[None, :], tile) 

2813 

2814 

2815@triton.jit 

2816def _mr_bidiag_rstep_kernel(W, U, E, TAU, ACC, J, K, RS, WPITCH, UPITCH, APITCH): 

2817 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

2818 wbase = W + pid * WPITCH 

2819 lc = tl.arange(0, 64) 

2820 ssq = tl.zeros((), dtype=tl.float32) 

2821 x0 = tl.zeros((), dtype=tl.float32) 

2822 # single pass (see _mr_bidiag_lstep_kernel); columns <= J contribute 

2823 # nothing (u has support on c > J), so start at the (J+1)'s tile. 

2824 for cb in tl.range((J + 1) // 64, (K + 63) // 64): 

2825 c0 = cb * 64 

2826 ch = tl.load(wbase + (c0 + lc) * RS + J, mask=(c0 + lc) < K, other=0.0) 

2827 ch = ch * ((c0 + lc) > J).to(tl.float32) 

2828 tl.store(U + pid * UPITCH + J * K + c0 + lc, ch, mask=(c0 + lc) < K) 

2829 ssq += tl.sum(ch * ch, axis=0) 

2830 x0 += tl.sum(ch * ((c0 + lc > J) & (c0 + lc < J + 2)).to(tl.float32), axis=0) 

2831 sigma = tl.sqrt(ssq) 

2832 alpha = tl.where(x0 >= 0.0, -sigma, sigma) 

2833 vnorm2 = 2.0 * sigma * (sigma + tl.abs(x0)) 

2834 tau = tl.where(vnorm2 > 0.0, 2.0 / vnorm2, 0.0) 

2835 tl.store(U + pid * UPITCH + J * K + (J + 1), x0 - alpha) 

2836 tl.store(E + pid * K + J, alpha) 

2837 tl.store(TAU + pid * K + J, tau) 

2838 for cb in tl.range(0, APITCH // 64): 

2839 tl.store(ACC + pid * APITCH + cb * 64 + lc, tl.zeros((64,), dtype=tl.float32)) 

2840 

2841 

2842@triton.jit 

2843def _mr_bidiag_rmat_kernel(W, U, ACC, J, K, RS, WPITCH, UPITCH, APITCH, NCC, CC0): 

2844 # Column tiles below CC0 = (J+1) // 64 are skipped: u is zero on 

2845 # columns <= J, so they contribute nothing to the reduction. 

2846 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

2847 flat = tl.program_id(1) 

2848 rt = flat // NCC 

2849 cc = flat % NCC 

2850 r0 = J + 1 + rt * 64 

2851 lc = tl.arange(0, 64) 

2852 lr = tl.arange(0, 64) 

2853 c0 = (CC0 + cc) * 64 

2854 wbase = W + pid * WPITCH 

2855 # the J+1-aligned row grid is not 64-aligned, so the last tile straddles 

2856 # the RS row pitch; mask it (the wrapped-around address is the NEXT 

2857 # column's row 0 -- an out-of-bounds read/write otherwise) 

2858 rmask = (r0 + lr) < RS 

2859 tile = tl.load( 

2860 wbase + (c0 + lc)[:, None] * RS + (r0 + lr)[None, :], 

2861 mask=rmask[None, :], 

2862 other=0.0, 

2863 ) 

2864 up = tl.load(U + pid * UPITCH + J * K + c0 + lc, mask=(c0 + lc) < K, other=0.0) 

2865 part = tl.sum(tl.trans(tile) * up[None, :], axis=1) 

2866 tl.atomic_add(ACC + pid * APITCH + r0 + lr, part) 

2867 

2868 

2869@triton.jit 

2870def _mr_bidiag_rapply_kernel( 

2871 W, U, TAU, ACC, J, K, RS, WPITCH, UPITCH, APITCH, NRC, NTR 

2872): 

2873 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

2874 flat = tl.program_id(1) 

2875 ct = flat // NTR 

2876 rc = flat % NTR 

2877 c0 = J + 1 + ct * 64 

2878 r0 = J + 1 + rc * 64 

2879 lc = tl.arange(0, 64) 

2880 lr = tl.arange(0, 64) 

2881 wbase = W + pid * WPITCH 

2882 tau = tl.load(TAU + pid * K + J) 

2883 rmask = (r0 + lr) < RS 

2884 wu = tl.load(ACC + pid * APITCH + r0 + lr, mask=rmask, other=0.0) * tau 

2885 up = tl.load(U + pid * UPITCH + J * K + c0 + lc, mask=(c0 + lc) < K, other=0.0) 

2886 tile = tl.load( 

2887 wbase + (c0 + lc)[:, None] * RS + (r0 + lr)[None, :], 

2888 mask=rmask[None, :], 

2889 other=0.0, 

2890 ) 

2891 tile = tile - tl.reshape(up, (64, 1)) * tl.reshape(wu, (1, 64)) 

2892 tl.store( 

2893 wbase + (c0 + lc)[:, None] * RS + (r0 + lr)[None, :], tile, mask=rmask[None, :] 

2894 ) 

2895 

2896 

2897@triton.jit 

2898def _mr_tridiag_step_kernel(W, V, D, E, TAU, ACC, CSCA, J, K, RS, WPITCH, APITCH): 

2899 # Hermitian (symmetric) one-sided Householder tridiagonalization, step J: 

2900 # column J below the diagonal defines the reflector (support rows > J), 

2901 # D[J] = W[J,J] (untouched by this step's reflection), E[J] = +/-sigma. 

2902 # Single pass (provisional v store + scalar pivot overwrite, see 

2903 # _mr_bidiag_lstep_kernel); also zeroes the ACC/CSCA accumulation slots 

2904 # that the mat kernel's atomics add into. 

2905 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

2906 wbase = W + pid * WPITCH 

2907 lr = tl.arange(0, 64) 

2908 dj = tl.zeros((), dtype=tl.float32) 

2909 ssq = tl.zeros((), dtype=tl.float32) 

2910 x0 = tl.zeros((), dtype=tl.float32) 

2911 for rb in tl.range(J // 64, (K + 63) // 64): 

2912 r0 = rb * 64 

2913 chf = tl.load(wbase + J * RS + r0 + lr) 

2914 dj += tl.sum( 

2915 chf * ((r0 + lr > J - 1) & (r0 + lr < J + 1)).to(tl.float32), axis=0 

2916 ) 

2917 ch = chf * ((r0 + lr) > J).to(tl.float32) 

2918 tl.store(V + pid * WPITCH + J * RS + r0 + lr, ch) 

2919 ssq += tl.sum(ch * ch, axis=0) 

2920 x0 += tl.sum(ch * ((r0 + lr > J) & (r0 + lr < J + 2)).to(tl.float32), axis=0) 

2921 sigma = tl.sqrt(ssq) 

2922 alpha = tl.where(x0 >= 0.0, -sigma, sigma) 

2923 vnorm2 = 2.0 * sigma * (sigma + tl.abs(x0)) 

2924 tau = tl.where(vnorm2 > 0.0, 2.0 / vnorm2, 0.0) 

2925 tl.store(V + pid * WPITCH + J * RS + (J + 1), x0 - alpha) 

2926 tl.store(D + pid * K + J, dj) 

2927 tl.store(E + pid * K + J, alpha) 

2928 tl.store(TAU + pid * K + J, tau) 

2929 tl.store(CSCA + pid, tl.zeros((), dtype=tl.float32)) 

2930 for cb in tl.range((J + 1) // 64, APITCH // 64): 

2931 tl.store(ACC + pid * APITCH + cb * 64 + lr, tl.zeros((64,), dtype=tl.float32)) 

2932 

2933 

2934@triton.jit 

2935def _mr_tridiag_mat_kernel(W, V, ACC, CSCA, J, K, RS, WPITCH, APITCH, NRT): 

2936 # omega = W_trailing . v (symmetric matvec), multi-program over 

2937 # (col tile, row strip) with atomic accumulation. NRT counts the 

2938 # K-trimmed trailing tiles (cdiv(K-1-J, 64)): with c0/r0 = J+1+tile*64 

2939 # the last tile reaches at most K+62 < RS, so no row-pitch straddle 

2940 # and no masks (pad rows/cols are zeros by construction and excluded 

2941 # entirely). Each program also accumulates its slice of v^T omega 

2942 # into CSCA (for the rank-2 correction coefficient in apply). 

2943 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

2944 flat = tl.program_id(1) 

2945 ct = flat // NRT 

2946 rt = flat % NRT 

2947 c0 = J + 1 + ct * 64 

2948 r0 = J + 1 + rt * 64 

2949 lc = tl.arange(0, 64) 

2950 lr = tl.arange(0, 64) 

2951 wbase = W + pid * WPITCH 

2952 tile = tl.load(wbase + (c0 + lc)[:, None] * RS + (r0 + lr)[None, :]) 

2953 vc = tl.load(V + pid * WPITCH + J * RS + c0 + lc) 

2954 part = tl.sum(tl.trans(tile) * vc[None, :], axis=1) 

2955 tl.atomic_add(ACC + pid * APITCH + r0 + lr, part) 

2956 vp = tl.load(V + pid * WPITCH + J * RS + r0 + lr) 

2957 tl.atomic_add(CSCA + pid, tl.sum(part * vp, axis=0)) 

2958 

2959 

2960@triton.jit 

2961def _mr_tridiag_apply_kernel(W, V, TAU, ACC, CSCA, J, K, RS, WPITCH, APITCH, NRT): 

2962 # Trailing symmetric rank-2 update W -= v w^T + w v^T with 

2963 # w = tau*omega - (tau^2/2)(v^T omega) v (LAPACK DSYTD2 form), one 

2964 # program per (col tile, row strip) of the K-trimmed trailing block 

2965 # (tiles never reach RS, so no masks). 

2966 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

2967 flat = tl.program_id(1) 

2968 ct = flat // NRT 

2969 rt = flat % NRT 

2970 c0 = J + 1 + ct * 64 

2971 r0 = J + 1 + rt * 64 

2972 lc = tl.arange(0, 64) 

2973 lr = tl.arange(0, 64) 

2974 wbase = W + pid * WPITCH 

2975 tau = tl.load(TAU + pid * K + J) 

2976 cs = tl.load(CSCA + pid) 

2977 # coef = (tau^2/2)(v^T omega): evaluate as tau*(tau*cs), NOT tau*tau*cs. 

2978 # When the trailing subdiagonal deflates (sigma ~ 1e-10 on clustered or 

2979 # strongly rank-deficient spectra), tau = 2/vnorm2 ~ 1e20 and tau*tau 

2980 # overflows fp32 (2e40 > 3.4e38) even though the final coefficient is 

2981 # O(1) -- verified: W diagonal corrupted to -inf, then 0*inf -> NaN in 

2982 # the next step's float mask. The regrouped form never squares tau. 

2983 coef = 0.5 * tau * (tau * cs) 

2984 om_r = tl.load(ACC + pid * APITCH + r0 + lr) 

2985 v_r = tl.load(V + pid * WPITCH + J * RS + r0 + lr) 

2986 om_c = tl.load(ACC + pid * APITCH + c0 + lc) 

2987 v_c = tl.load(V + pid * WPITCH + J * RS + c0 + lc) 

2988 w_r = tau * om_r - coef * v_r 

2989 w_c = tau * om_c - coef * v_c 

2990 ptrs = wbase + (c0 + lc)[:, None] * RS + (r0 + lr)[None, :] 

2991 tile = tl.load(ptrs) 

2992 tile = tile - tl.reshape(v_c, (64, 1)) * tl.reshape(w_r, (1, 64)) 

2993 tile = tile - tl.reshape(w_c, (64, 1)) * tl.reshape(v_r, (1, 64)) 

2994 tl.store(ptrs, tile) 

2995 

2996 

2997@triton.jit 

2998def _mr_bidiag_to_tridiag_kernel(D, E, DD, EE, K, BLOCK: tl.constexpr): 

2999 # Construct the B^T B tridiagonal (dd_i = d_i^2 + e_{i-1}^2, 

3000 # ee_i = d_i * e_i) from the raw bidiagonal d/e, in its OWN launch: 

3001 # the Sturm kernels then only READ global memory. All loads happen 

3002 # before the stores -- a same-kernel store->load round trip is not 

3003 # ordered on this backend (MTE3 store / MTE2 load), so the consumer 

3004 # must live behind a kernel boundary. DD/EE are SEPARATE buffers: the 

3005 # fp32 tridiagonal has an absolute element rounding of ~eps*sigma_max^2, 

3006 # which swamps any squared singular value below ~(sqrt(eps)*sigma_max)^2 

3007 # -- i.e. everything near the default tolerance (k*eps*sigma_max). The 

3008 # decisive df64 kernel therefore works from the RAW d/e instead (their 

3009 # relative precision is ~K*eps regardless of conditioning) and squares 

3010 # them inside the df64 arithmetic. 

3011 batch = tl.program_id(0) 

3012 kidx = tl.arange(0, BLOCK) 

3013 base = batch * K 

3014 kmask = kidx < K 

3015 d = tl.load(D + base + kidx, mask=kmask, other=0.0) 

3016 e_cur = tl.load(E + base + kidx, mask=kidx < K - 1, other=0.0) 

3017 e_prev = tl.load(E + base + kidx - 1, mask=(kidx >= 1) & kmask, other=0.0) 

3018 tl.store(DD + base + kidx, d * d + e_prev * e_prev, mask=kmask) 

3019 tl.store(EE + base + kidx, d * e_cur, mask=kmask) 

3020 

3021 

3022@triton.jit 

3023def _mr_sturm_big_kernel( 

3024 D, 

3025 E, 

3026 ATOL, 

3027 RTOL, 

3028 OUT, 

3029 TOL2, 

3030 FLAG, 

3031 K, 

3032 BLOCK: tl.constexpr, 

3033 BISECT_ITERS: tl.constexpr, 

3034): 

3035 # Large-K variant of the bidiagonal Sturm count (no 2D tiles: those do 

3036 # not compile past 64 wide). D/E already hold the FINAL B^T B 

3037 # tridiagonal, written by _mr_bidiag_to_tridiag_kernel in a previous 

3038 # launch, so this kernel only READS global memory. Counts 

3039 # #{sigma > max(atol, rtol*sigma_max)} with sigma_max bracketed by 

3040 # sqrt(max dd) / sqrt(Gershgorin) and refined by bisection only when 

3041 # the two bounds give different ranks. 

3042 batch = tl.program_id(0) 

3043 kidx = tl.arange(0, BLOCK) 

3044 base = batch * K 

3045 kmask = kidx < K 

3046 dd = tl.load(D + base + kidx, mask=kmask, other=0.0) 

3047 ee = tl.load(E + base + kidx, mask=kidx < K - 1, other=0.0) 

3048 ee_prev = tl.load(E + base + kidx - 1, mask=(kidx >= 1) & kmask, other=0.0) 

3049 gershgorin = tl.abs(dd) + tl.abs(ee) + tl.abs(ee_prev) 

3050 hi = tl.max(gershgorin, axis=0) 

3051 dmax = tl.max(dd, axis=0) 

3052 atol = tl.load(ATOL + batch) 

3053 rtol = tl.load(RTOL + batch) 

3054 if hi == 0.0: 

3055 # Zero matrix: rank 0. TOL2 must still be written: the final df64 

3056 # kernel runs unconditionally and reads it -- an uninitialized tol2 

3057 # (e.g. a negative value recycled by the caching allocator) makes 

3058 # the df64 count report full rank and overwrites the zero result. 

3059 tl.store(OUT + batch, tl.zeros((), dtype=tl.int64)) 

3060 tl.store(TOL2 + batch, 0.0) 

3061 tl.store(FLAG + batch, tl.zeros((), dtype=tl.int64)) 

3062 else: 

3063 sigma_lo = tl.sqrt(tl.maximum(dmax, 0.0)) 

3064 sigma_hi = tl.sqrt(hi) 

3065 tol_lo = tl.maximum(atol, rtol * sigma_lo) 

3066 tol_hi = tl.maximum(atol, rtol * sigma_hi) 

3067 cnt_lo = _sturm_count_less(D, E, base, K, tol_lo * tol_lo) 

3068 cnt_hi = _sturm_count_less(D, E, base, K, tol_hi * tol_hi) 

3069 rank_lo = K - cnt_lo 

3070 rank_hi = K - cnt_hi 

3071 rank = rank_lo 

3072 refine = rank_lo != rank_hi 

3073 tol2 = tol_lo * tol_lo 

3074 if refine: 

3075 lo = tl.maximum(dmax, 0.0) 

3076 hi_p = hi * (1.0 + 1e-9) + 1e-30 

3077 it = 0 

3078 while it < BISECT_ITERS: 

3079 mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi_p) 

3080 cnt = _sturm_count_less(D, E, base, K, mid) 

3081 if cnt >= K: 

3082 hi_p = mid 

3083 else: 

3084 lo = mid 

3085 it += 1 

3086 lmax = 0.5 * (lo + hi_p) 

3087 sigma_max = tl.sqrt(lmax) 

3088 tol2 = tl.maximum(atol, rtol * sigma_max) 

3089 tol2 = tol2 * tol2 

3090 # The final Sturm count runs in a separate kernel: a while-loop count 

3091 # directly after the bisection while-loop miscomputes on this backend 

3092 # (verified: wrong pivot signs). tol2/flag hand off through GM. 

3093 tl.store(OUT + batch, rank.to(tl.int64)) 

3094 tl.store(TOL2 + batch, tol2) 

3095 tl.store(FLAG + batch, refine.to(tl.int64)) 

3096 

3097 

3098@triton.jit 

3099def _df64_add(h1, l1, h2, l2): 

3100 # Error-free addition of two double-single numbers (Knuth TwoSum on the 

3101 # hi parts, lo parts gathered afterwards, then one renormalization). 

3102 s = h1 + h2 

3103 z = s - h1 

3104 e = (h1 - (s - z)) + (h2 - z) 

3105 lo = l1 + l2 + e 

3106 h = s + lo 

3107 e2 = lo - (h - s) 

3108 return h, e2 

3109 

3110 

3111@triton.jit 

3112def _df64_mul_ds(a_h, a_l, b_h, b_l): 

3113 # Double-single product: TwoProd on the hi parts plus the cross terms. 

3114 p = a_h * b_h 

3115 e = tl.fma(a_h, b_h, -p) + a_h * b_l + a_l * b_h 

3116 h = p + e 

3117 low = e - (h - p) 

3118 return h, low 

3119 

3120 

3121@triton.jit 

3122def _df64_div_ds(a_h, a_l, b_h, b_l): 

3123 # Double-single division: fp32 quotient plus one df64 correction step. 

3124 q1 = a_h / b_h 

3125 p = q1 * b_h 

3126 pe = tl.fma(q1, b_h, -p) 

3127 r_h, r_l = _df64_add(a_h, a_l, -p, -(pe + q1 * b_l)) 

3128 q2 = r_h / b_h 

3129 h = q1 + q2 

3130 low = q2 - (h - q1) 

3131 return h, low 

3132 

3133 

3134@triton.jit 

3135def _mr_sturm_final_kernel(D, E, TOL2, FLAG, OUT, K): 

3136 # The decisive count, in double-single (df64) arithmetic, from the RAW 

3137 # bidiagonal d/e (NOT the fp32 dd/ee tridiagonal: squaring into fp32 

3138 # rounds each dd/ee absolutely by ~eps*sigma_max^2, which swamps any 

3139 # lambda near the default tol^2 ~ (k*eps*sigma_max)^2 -- a sqrt(eps) 

3140 # noise floor in the sigma domain). Squaring the fp32 d/e inside df64 

3141 # keeps every intermediate at ~eps^2 relative precision. The qd 

3142 # recurrence for B^T B: dd_i = d_i^2 + e_{i-1}^2, ee_i = d_i*e_i, 

3143 # q_i = dd_i - tol2 - ee_{i-1}^2 / q_{i-1}. 

3144 # Requires enable_fp_fusion=False (fma contraction breaks the 

3145 # TwoSum/TwoProd error-free transforms). 

3146 batch = tl.program_id(0) 

3147 tol2 = tl.load(TOL2 + batch) 

3148 base = batch * K 

3149 d0 = tl.load(D + base) 

3150 d0h, d0l = _df64_mul_ds(d0, 0.0, d0, 0.0) 

3151 q_h, q_l = _df64_add(d0h, d0l, -tol2, 0.0) 

3152 zero = (q_h == 0.0) & (q_l == 0.0) 

3153 q_h = tl.where(zero, -1.1754944e-38, q_h) 

3154 q_l = tl.where(zero, 0.0, q_l) 

3155 neg = ((q_h < 0.0) | ((q_h == 0.0) & (q_l < 0.0))).to(tl.int32) 

3156 dprev = d0 

3157 i = 1 

3158 while i < K: 

3159 di = tl.load(D + base + i) 

3160 ei = tl.load(E + base + i - 1) 

3161 dih, dil = _df64_mul_ds(di, 0.0, di, 0.0) 

3162 eih, eil = _df64_mul_ds(ei, 0.0, ei, 0.0) 

3163 dd_h, dd_l = _df64_add(dih, dil, eih, eil) 

3164 ph, pl = _df64_mul_ds(dprev, 0.0, ei, 0.0) 

3165 ee_h, ee_l = _df64_mul_ds(ph, pl, ph, pl) 

3166 qd_h, qd_l = _df64_div_ds(ee_h, ee_l, q_h, q_l) 

3167 s_h, s_l = _df64_add(dd_h, dd_l, -tol2, 0.0) 

3168 q_h, q_l = _df64_add(s_h, s_l, -qd_h, -qd_l) 

3169 zero = (q_h == 0.0) & (q_l == 0.0) 

3170 q_h = tl.where(zero, -1.1754944e-38, q_h) 

3171 q_l = tl.where(zero, 0.0, q_l) 

3172 neg += ((q_h < 0.0) | ((q_h == 0.0) & (q_l < 0.0))).to(tl.int32) 

3173 dprev = di 

3174 i += 1 

3175 rank_b = (K - neg).to(tl.int64) 

3176 # always take the df64 count: the fp32 bracket counts in kernel A are only 

3177 # used to bound sigma_max / trigger the bisection, never for the answer. 

3178 tl.store(OUT + batch, rank_b) 

3179 

3180 

3181@triton.jit 

3182def _mr_sturm_big_tridiag_kernel( 

3183 D, 

3184 E, 

3185 ATOL, 

3186 RTOL, 

3187 OUT, 

3188 TOL2, 

3189 FLAG, 

3190 K, 

3191 BLOCK: tl.constexpr, 

3192 BISECT_ITERS: tl.constexpr, 

3193): 

3194 # Hermitian Sturm bracket on the RAW tridiagonal (d, e) -- the 

3195 # eigenvalue-domain counterpart of _mr_sturm_big_kernel. Counts 

3196 # #{|lambda| > max(atol, rtol*|lambda|max)} = (K - cle(tol)) + clt(-tol) 

3197 # where cle(x) = #{lambda <= x} (zero pivot -> tiny negative) and 

3198 # clt(x) = #{lambda < x} STRICTLY (zero pivot -> tiny positive), both 

3199 # from _sturm_count_posneg2. |lambda|max is 

3200 # bracketed by [max|d_i|, max Gershgorin radius] (max_i |d_ii| <= 

3201 # |lambda|max by Rayleigh) and refined by bisection on 

3202 # f(x) = #{|lambda| > x} only when the two bounds give different ranks. 

3203 # TOL2 hands the (LINEAR, not squared) tolerance to the decisive df64 

3204 # kernel; the flag convention matches _mr_sturm_big_kernel. 

3205 batch = tl.program_id(0) 

3206 kidx = tl.arange(0, BLOCK) 

3207 base = batch * K 

3208 kmask = kidx < K 

3209 d = tl.load(D + base + kidx, mask=kmask, other=0.0) 

3210 ee = tl.load(E + base + kidx, mask=kidx < K - 1, other=0.0) 

3211 ee_prev = tl.load(E + base + kidx - 1, mask=(kidx >= 1) & kmask, other=0.0) 

3212 gershgorin = tl.abs(d) + tl.abs(ee) + tl.abs(ee_prev) 

3213 hi = tl.max(gershgorin, axis=0) 

3214 dmax = tl.max(tl.abs(d), axis=0) 

3215 atol = tl.load(ATOL + batch) 

3216 rtol = tl.load(RTOL + batch) 

3217 if hi == 0.0: 

3218 tl.store(OUT + batch, tl.zeros((), dtype=tl.int64)) 

3219 tl.store(TOL2 + batch, 0.0) 

3220 tl.store(FLAG + batch, tl.zeros((), dtype=tl.int64)) 

3221 else: 

3222 tol_lo = tl.maximum(atol, rtol * dmax) 

3223 tol_hi = tl.maximum(atol, rtol * hi) 

3224 c_lo, m_lo = _sturm_count_posneg2(D, E, base, K, tol_lo, -tol_lo) 

3225 c_hi, m_hi = _sturm_count_posneg2(D, E, base, K, tol_hi, -tol_hi) 

3226 rank_lo = K - c_lo + m_lo 

3227 rank_hi = K - c_hi + m_hi 

3228 tol2 = tol_lo 

3229 if rank_lo != rank_hi: 

3230 # bisect |lambda|max on [dmax, hi]: f(x) = #{|lambda| > x} is 

3231 # monotone; |lambda|max = sup{x : f(x) > 0} 

3232 lo = dmax 

3233 hi_p = hi * (1.0 + 1e-9) + 1e-30 

3234 it = 0 

3235 while it < BISECT_ITERS: 

3236 mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi_p) 

3237 c_m, m_m = _sturm_count_posneg2(D, E, base, K, mid, -mid) 

3238 if K - c_m + m_m >= 1: 

3239 lo = mid 

3240 else: 

3241 hi_p = mid 

3242 it += 1 

3243 lmax = 0.5 * (lo + hi_p) 

3244 tol2 = tl.maximum(atol, rtol * lmax) 

3245 refine = rank_lo != rank_hi 

3246 tl.store(OUT + batch, rank_lo.to(tl.int64)) 

3247 tl.store(TOL2 + batch, tol2) 

3248 tl.store(FLAG + batch, refine.to(tl.int64)) 

3249 

3250 

3251@triton.jit 

3252def _mr_sturm_final_tridiag_kernel(D, E, TOL2, FLAG, OUT, K): 

3253 # Decisive hermitian count in df64 arithmetic from the RAW tridiagonal: 

3254 # rank = #{lambda > tol} + #{lambda < -tol}, two lockstep qd chains 

3255 # q_i = d_i - x - e_{i-1}^2 / q_{i-1}. The positive chain runs at 

3256 # x = tol with the DLANEG guard (zero pivot -> tiny negative), so it 

3257 # counts #{lambda <= tol} and K - neg1 IS the strict #{lambda > tol}; 

3258 # the negative chain runs at x = -tol with the MIRRORED guard (zero 

3259 # pivot -> tiny positive), so neg2 IS the strict #{lambda < -tol} -- 

3260 # exact for every tol, including tol == 0, where it yields 

3261 # #{lambda < 0} (a nonzero rank-deficient spectrum is counted 

3262 # correctly, no special-casing). Same df64 primitives as 

3263 # _mr_sturm_final_kernel; the e^2 terms are TwoProd'd so the recurrence 

3264 # keeps ~eps^2 relative precision. Requires enable_fp_fusion=False. 

3265 batch = tl.program_id(0) 

3266 tol = tl.load(TOL2 + batch) 

3267 xn = -tol 

3268 base = batch * K 

3269 d0 = tl.load(D + base) 

3270 q1h, q1l = _df64_add(d0, 0.0, -tol, 0.0) 

3271 q2h, q2l = _df64_add(d0, 0.0, -xn, 0.0) 

3272 zero1 = (q1h == 0.0) & (q1l == 0.0) 

3273 q1h = tl.where(zero1, -1.1754944e-38, q1h) 

3274 q1l = tl.where(zero1, 0.0, q1l) 

3275 zero2 = (q2h == 0.0) & (q2l == 0.0) 

3276 q2h = tl.where(zero2, 1.1754944e-38, q2h) 

3277 q2l = tl.where(zero2, 0.0, q2l) 

3278 neg1 = ((q1h < 0.0) | ((q1h == 0.0) & (q1l < 0.0))).to(tl.int32) 

3279 neg2 = ((q2h < 0.0) | ((q2h == 0.0) & (q2l < 0.0))).to(tl.int32) 

3280 i = 1 

3281 while i < K: 

3282 di = tl.load(D + base + i) 

3283 ei = tl.load(E + base + i - 1) 

3284 eih, eil = _df64_mul_ds(ei, 0.0, ei, 0.0) 

3285 qd1h, qd1l = _df64_div_ds(eih, eil, q1h, q1l) 

3286 s1h, s1l = _df64_add(di, 0.0, -tol, 0.0) 

3287 q1h, q1l = _df64_add(s1h, s1l, -qd1h, -qd1l) 

3288 qd2h, qd2l = _df64_div_ds(eih, eil, q2h, q2l) 

3289 s2h, s2l = _df64_add(di, 0.0, -xn, 0.0) 

3290 q2h, q2l = _df64_add(s2h, s2l, -qd2h, -qd2l) 

3291 zero1 = (q1h == 0.0) & (q1l == 0.0) 

3292 q1h = tl.where(zero1, -1.1754944e-38, q1h) 

3293 q1l = tl.where(zero1, 0.0, q1l) 

3294 zero2 = (q2h == 0.0) & (q2l == 0.0) 

3295 q2h = tl.where(zero2, 1.1754944e-38, q2h) 

3296 q2l = tl.where(zero2, 0.0, q2l) 

3297 neg1 += ((q1h < 0.0) | ((q1h == 0.0) & (q1l < 0.0))).to(tl.int32) 

3298 neg2 += ((q2h < 0.0) | ((q2h == 0.0) & (q2l < 0.0))).to(tl.int32) 

3299 i += 1 

3300 rank = (K - neg1) + neg2 

3301 tl.store(OUT + batch, rank.to(tl.int64)) 

3302 

3303 

3304def _bidiag_workspace(dev, batch_count, k, rows): 

3305 kp = triton.cdiv(k, 64) * 64 + 64 # one slack tile: tile accesses are 

3306 rs = triton.cdiv(rows, 64) * 64 + 64 # unmasked and must not run off 

3307 block_k = max(triton.next_power_of_2(k), 64) 

3308 return { 

3309 "kp": kp, 

3310 "rs": rs, 

3311 "wpitch": kp * rs, 

3312 "upitch": kp * (k + 64), 

3313 "block_k": block_k, 

3314 "W": torch.zeros((batch_count, kp, rs), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3315 "V": torch.zeros((batch_count, kp, rs), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3316 "U": torch.zeros((batch_count, kp * (k + 64)), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3317 "dbuf": torch.zeros((batch_count, k), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3318 "ebuf": torch.zeros((batch_count, k), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3319 # fp32 B^T B tridiagonal for the bracket counts only; the decisive 

3320 # df64 count works from the RAW d/e (see _mr_bidiag_to_tridiag_kernel). 

3321 "ddbuf": torch.empty((batch_count, k), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3322 "eebuf": torch.empty((batch_count, k), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3323 "taul": torch.zeros((batch_count, k), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3324 "taur": torch.zeros((batch_count, k), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3325 "nrm2": torch.empty((batch_count, k), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3326 "frob": torch.zeros((batch_count,), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3327 # One extra tile of slack: the right matvec's atomic accumulation 

3328 # index r0 + 63 can reach rs (pad-row tiles are updated, never read). 

3329 "acc": torch.zeros((batch_count, kp + 64), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3330 "uacc": torch.zeros((batch_count, rs + 64), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3331 "tol2": torch.empty((batch_count,), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3332 "flag": torch.empty((batch_count,), dtype=torch.int64, device=dev), 

3333 "atol": torch.empty((batch_count,), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3334 "rtol": torch.empty((batch_count,), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3335 "out": torch.empty((batch_count,), dtype=torch.int64, device=dev), 

3336 } 

3337 

3338 

3339def _bidiag_run( 

3340 ws, matrix, atol_tensor, rtol_tensor, m, n, k, rows, batch_count, hermitian 

3341): 

3342 """The launch sequence of the unblocked Golub-Kahan bidiagonalization. 

3343 

3344 Written as a pure function of the workspace so it can run either 

3345 directly or under an NPUGraph capture (graph capture requires stable 

3346 buffer addresses across replays).""" 

3347 kp, rs, block_k = ws["kp"], ws["rs"], ws["block_k"] 

3348 wpitch, upitch = ws["wpitch"], ws["upitch"] 

3349 W, V, U = ws["W"], ws["V"], ws["U"] 

3350 dbuf, ebuf, ddbuf, eebuf = ws["dbuf"], ws["ebuf"], ws["ddbuf"], ws["eebuf"] 

3351 taul, taur = ws["taul"], ws["taur"] 

3352 nrm2, frob, acc, uacc = ws["nrm2"], ws["frob"], ws["acc"], ws["uacc"] 

3353 _fast_launch( 

3354 _mr_rrqr_init_kernel, 

3355 (batch_count, (kp - 64) // 64), 

3356 matrix, 

3357 W, 

3358 nrm2, 

3359 frob, 

3360 m, 

3361 n, 

3362 k, 

3363 rows, 

3364 rs, 

3365 wpitch, 

3366 TALL=m >= n, 

3367 HERMITIAN=hermitian, 

3368 num_warps=4, 

3369 num_stages=1, 

3370 ) 

3371 nrc_full = (rs - 64) // 64 

3372 ncc_full = (kp - 64) // 64 

3373 # Valid row tiles = cdiv(rows, 64); the workspace rs carries one extra 

3374 # slack tile (for unmasked addressing) plus up to 63 pad rows, all zeros 

3375 # forever, so iterating them in the step/mat/apply kernels is pure waste 

3376 # (for near-square 129^2 it doubles the right-side tile count). 

3377 rbv = (rows + 63) // 64 

3378 for j in range(k): 

3379 ntl = triton.cdiv(k - 1 - j, 64) 

3380 # trim the matvec/apply grids to the trailing block: v/u are zero 

3381 # above/left of j, so those tiles are pure waste (halves the 

3382 # average per-step work of the four big kernels). 

3383 rb0 = j // 64 

3384 nrct = nrc_full - rb0 

3385 _fast_launch( 

3386 _mr_bidiag_lstep_kernel, 

3387 (batch_count,), 

3388 W, 

3389 V, 

3390 dbuf, 

3391 taul, 

3392 acc, 

3393 j, 

3394 k, 

3395 rs, 

3396 wpitch, 

3397 kp, 

3398 rbv, 

3399 num_warps=4, 

3400 num_stages=1, 

3401 ) 

3402 if ntl > 0: 

3403 _fast_launch( 

3404 _mr_bidiag_lmat_kernel, 

3405 (batch_count, ntl * nrct), 

3406 W, 

3407 V, 

3408 acc, 

3409 j, 

3410 k, 

3411 rs, 

3412 wpitch, 

3413 kp, 

3414 nrct, 

3415 rb0, 

3416 num_warps=4, 

3417 num_stages=1, 

3418 ) 

3419 _fast_launch( 

3420 _mr_bidiag_lapply_kernel, 

3421 (batch_count, ntl * nrct), 

3422 W, 

3423 V, 

3424 taul, 

3425 acc, 

3426 j, 

3427 k, 

3428 rs, 

3429 wpitch, 

3430 kp, 

3431 nrct, 

3432 rb0, 

3433 num_warps=4, 

3434 num_stages=1, 

3435 ) 

3436 if j + 1 < k: 

3437 # valid row tiles only (see rbv above): rows j+1 .. rows-1 

3438 ntr = triton.cdiv(rows - 1 - j, 64) 

3439 cc0 = (j + 1) // 64 

3440 ncct = ncc_full - cc0 

3441 _fast_launch( 

3442 _mr_bidiag_rstep_kernel, 

3443 (batch_count,), 

3444 W, 

3445 U, 

3446 ebuf, 

3447 taur, 

3448 uacc, 

3449 j, 

3450 k, 

3451 rs, 

3452 wpitch, 

3453 upitch, 

3454 rs, 

3455 num_warps=4, 

3456 num_stages=1, 

3457 ) 

3458 _fast_launch( 

3459 _mr_bidiag_rmat_kernel, 

3460 (batch_count, ntr * ncct), 

3461 W, 

3462 U, 

3463 uacc, 

3464 j, 

3465 k, 

3466 rs, 

3467 wpitch, 

3468 upitch, 

3469 rs, 

3470 ncct, 

3471 cc0, 

3472 num_warps=4, 

3473 num_stages=1, 

3474 ) 

3475 _fast_launch( 

3476 _mr_bidiag_rapply_kernel, 

3477 (batch_count, ntl * ntr), 

3478 W, 

3479 U, 

3480 taur, 

3481 uacc, 

3482 j, 

3483 k, 

3484 rs, 

3485 wpitch, 

3486 upitch, 

3487 rs, 

3488 (rs - 64) // 64, 

3489 ntr, 

3490 num_warps=4, 

3491 num_stages=1, 

3492 ) 

3493 _fast_launch( 

3494 _mr_bidiag_to_tridiag_kernel, 

3495 (batch_count,), 

3496 dbuf, 

3497 ebuf, 

3498 ddbuf, 

3499 eebuf, 

3500 k, 

3501 BLOCK=block_k, 

3502 num_warps=1, 

3503 num_stages=1, 

3504 ) 

3505 _fast_launch( 

3506 _mr_sturm_big_kernel, 

3507 (batch_count,), 

3508 ddbuf, 

3509 eebuf, 

3510 atol_tensor, 

3511 rtol_tensor, 

3512 ws["out"], 

3513 ws["tol2"], 

3514 ws["flag"], 

3515 k, 

3516 BLOCK=block_k, 

3517 BISECT_ITERS=32, 

3518 num_warps=1, 

3519 num_stages=1, 

3520 ) 

3521 _fast_launch( 

3522 _mr_sturm_final_kernel, 

3523 (batch_count,), 

3524 dbuf, 

3525 ebuf, 

3526 ws["tol2"], 

3527 ws["flag"], 

3528 ws["out"], 

3529 k, 

3530 num_warps=1, 

3531 num_stages=1, 

3532 enable_fp_fusion=False, 

3533 ) 

3534 

3535 

3536# Per-shape NPUGraph cache for the bidiag path. The unblocked GK loop 

3537# issues 6k kernel launches; on this host each _fast_launch costs ~80us of 

3538# HOST time (slow ARM CPU), so a k=512 call spends ~100x more time 

3539# enqueueing than the device spends executing. Capturing the sequence once 

3540# per shape and replaying it collapses the host cost to ~1us/launch 

3541# (measured: 300 captured launches replay in 286us vs 124ms direct). 

3542# Buffers are persistent per cache entry; only the input matrix and the 

3543# tolerances are copied in per call, and the rank out of it. 

3544# 

3545# Concurrency: the cache key includes the current stream (a capture is only 

3546# valid on its own stream), and ALL cache access (lookup, capture, staging 

3547# copy, replay) is serialized by a module-level lock -- otherwise two 

3548# threads calling with the same shape on the same device would race on the 

3549# shared staging/tolerance/out buffers. Eviction is FIFO-one (the dict 

3550# preserves insertion order), not clear-all: shape churn beyond 

3551# _*_GRAPH_MAX_ENTRIES re-captures one entry instead of all of them. 

3552_GRAPH_LOCK = threading.Lock() 

3553 

3554 

3555def _current_stream_key(device): 

3556 try: 

3557 stream = torch.npu.current_stream(device) 

3558 for attr in ("cuda_stream", "npu_stream", "stream_id"): 

3559 handle = getattr(stream, attr, None) 

3560 if handle is not None: 

3561 return handle 

3562 return id(stream) 

3563 except Exception: 

3564 return None 

3565 

3566 

3567_BIDIAG_GRAPHS = {} 

3568_BIDIAG_GRAPH_MAX_ENTRIES = 16 

3569 

3570 

3571def _launch_bidiag_rank( 

3572 matrix, 

3573 atol_tensor, 

3574 rtol_tensor, 

3575 out, 

3576 m, 

3577 n, 

3578 k, 

3579 rows, 

3580 batch_count, 

3581 input, 

3582 hermitian, 

3583): 

3584 """Unblocked Golub-Kahan bidiagonalization + Sturm count (fp32; the 

3585 default for every non-hermitian k > 64 -- k > 255 always, and compact 

3586 64 < k <= 255 even when FLAGGEMS_MR_FAST_PATH=1; only long-row inputs in 

3587 that band may opt into the unpivoted QR). 

3588 

3589 SVD-accurate rank: unlike the RRQR path (|R_ii| only approximate sigma_i), 

3590 the bidiagonal d/e keep every singular value at linear precision and the 

3591 Sturm count is exact, so borderline tolerances are resolved correctly. 

3592 Per step: six kernel launches (reflector / matvec / apply, left then 

3593 right); cross-program reductions use atomic accumulation and kernel 

3594 boundaries provide all ordering. Slower per step than the RRQR path but 

3595 exact -- used only where the QR pivot gap is a risk (large k). 

3596 

3597 The launch sequence is NPUGraph-captured per shape (see above); set 

3598 FLAGGEMS_MR_NO_GRAPH=1 to force direct launches. 

3599 """ 

3600 dev = input.device 

3601 # TRITON_ALL_BLOCKS_PARALLEL (set globally by the fused sparse-attention 

3602 # module at import) miscompiles the bidiag matvec/apply kernels (verified: 

3603 # wrong atomic-accumulated sums). It is read at kernel COMPILE time only, 

3604 # so pop it for the duration of this launcher (compiles happen here via 

3605 # _fast_launch warmups and the graph capture) and restore it afterwards. 

3606 # _GRAPH_LOCK serializes the WHOLE launcher, not just the graph cache: 

3607 # the TRITON_ALL_BLOCKS_PARALLEL pop/restore below is process-global 

3608 # state and kernel compiles happen inside this body (via _fast_launch 

3609 # warmups and graph capture), so a concurrent thread must neither 

3610 # interleave pop/restore nor compile while the variable is removed. 

3611 with _GRAPH_LOCK: 

3612 saved_all_blocks = os.environ.pop("TRITON_ALL_BLOCKS_PARALLEL", None) 

3613 try: 

3614 with torch_device_fn.device(input.device): 

3615 if os.environ.get("FLAGGEMS_MR_NO_GRAPH") == "1": 

3616 ws = _bidiag_workspace(dev, batch_count, k, rows) 

3617 _bidiag_run( 

3618 ws, 

3619 matrix, 

3620 atol_tensor, 

3621 rtol_tensor, 

3622 m, 

3623 n, 

3624 k, 

3625 rows, 

3626 batch_count, 

3627 hermitian, 

3628 ) 

3629 out.copy_(ws["out"].reshape(out.shape)) 

3630 return out 

3631 key = ( 

3632 m, 

3633 n, 

3634 batch_count, 

3635 hermitian, 

3636 input.device.index, 

3637 _current_stream_key(input.device), 

3638 ) 

3639 ent = _BIDIAG_GRAPHS.get(key) 

3640 if ent is None: 

3641 ws = _bidiag_workspace(dev, batch_count, k, rows) 

3642 staging = torch.empty( 

3643 (batch_count, m, n), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev 

3644 ) 

3645 staging.copy_(matrix) 

3646 ws["atol"].copy_(atol_tensor) 

3647 ws["rtol"].copy_(rtol_tensor) 

3648 # warm-up run: compiles every kernel/specialization 

3649 # (compile is illegal during capture) and fills 

3650 # _FAST_LAUNCH_CACHE 

3651 _bidiag_run( 

3652 ws, 

3653 staging, 

3654 ws["atol"], 

3655 ws["rtol"], 

3656 m, 

3657 n, 

3658 k, 

3659 rows, 

3660 batch_count, 

3661 hermitian, 

3662 ) 

3663 torch.npu.synchronize() 

3664 graph = torch.npu.NPUGraph() 

3665 try: 

3666 with torch.npu.graph(graph): 

3667 _bidiag_run( 

3668 ws, 

3669 staging, 

3670 ws["atol"], 

3671 ws["rtol"], 

3672 m, 

3673 n, 

3674 k, 

3675 rows, 

3676 batch_count, 

3677 hermitian, 

3678 ) 

3679 except Exception: 

3680 logger.warning( 

3681 "NPUGraph capture failed for matrix_rank bidiag " 

3682 "shape (%d, %d); falling back to direct launches", 

3683 m, 

3684 n, 

3685 ) 

3686 _bidiag_run( 

3687 ws, 

3688 staging, 

3689 ws["atol"], 

3690 ws["rtol"], 

3691 m, 

3692 n, 

3693 k, 

3694 rows, 

3695 batch_count, 

3696 hermitian, 

3697 ) 

3698 out.copy_(ws["out"].reshape(out.shape)) 

3699 return out 

3700 if len(_BIDIAG_GRAPHS) >= _BIDIAG_GRAPH_MAX_ENTRIES: 

3701 # An evicted graph may still have an in-flight 

3702 # replay (replay is async); dropping the entry frees 

3703 # its workspace. Rare event (17th distinct shape): 

3704 # drain before freeing. The cache is process-wide 

3705 # and the FIFO victim may live on ANOTHER device, so 

3706 # synchronize the victim's device (key[4]), not the 

3707 # current one. 

3708 victim_key = next(iter(_BIDIAG_GRAPHS)) 

3709 torch.npu.synchronize(victim_key[4]) 

3710 _BIDIAG_GRAPHS.pop(victim_key) 

3711 _BIDIAG_GRAPHS[key] = (ws, staging, graph) 

3712 ws, staging, graph = _BIDIAG_GRAPHS[key] 

3713 staging.copy_(matrix) 

3714 ws["atol"].copy_(atol_tensor) 

3715 ws["rtol"].copy_(rtol_tensor) 

3716 graph.replay() 

3717 out.copy_(ws["out"].reshape(out.shape)) 

3718 finally: 

3719 if saved_all_blocks is not None: 

3720 os.environ["TRITON_ALL_BLOCKS_PARALLEL"] = saved_all_blocks 

3721 return out 

3722 

3723 

3724_TRIDIAG_GRAPHS = {} 

3725_TRIDIAG_GRAPH_MAX_ENTRIES = 16 

3726 

3727 

3728def _tridiag_workspace(dev, batch_count, k, rows): 

3729 # Slim variant of _bidiag_workspace: the one-sided tridiagonalization 

3730 # needs no U/ddbuf/eebuf/taur (those are bidiag-only), saving ~40% of 

3731 # the per-entry memory. 

3732 kp = triton.cdiv(k, 64) * 64 + 64 

3733 rs = triton.cdiv(rows, 64) * 64 + 64 

3734 block_k = max(triton.next_power_of_2(k), 64) 

3735 return { 

3736 "kp": kp, 

3737 "rs": rs, 

3738 "wpitch": kp * rs, 

3739 "block_k": block_k, 

3740 "W": torch.zeros((batch_count, kp, rs), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3741 "V": torch.zeros((batch_count, kp, rs), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3742 "dbuf": torch.zeros((batch_count, k), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3743 "ebuf": torch.zeros((batch_count, k), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3744 "taul": torch.zeros((batch_count, k), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3745 "nrm2": torch.empty((batch_count, k), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3746 "frob": torch.zeros((batch_count,), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3747 "acc": torch.zeros((batch_count, kp + 64), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3748 "tol2": torch.empty((batch_count,), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3749 "flag": torch.empty((batch_count,), dtype=torch.int64, device=dev), 

3750 "atol": torch.empty((batch_count,), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3751 "rtol": torch.empty((batch_count,), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev), 

3752 "out": torch.empty((batch_count,), dtype=torch.int64, device=dev), 

3753 } 

3754 

3755 

3756def _tridiag_run(ws, matrix, atol_tensor, rtol_tensor, m, n, k, rows, batch_count): 

3757 """The launch sequence of the unblocked one-sided Householder 

3758 tridiagonalization (hermitian k > 64): three kernels per step 

3759 (reflector step / symmetric matvec / rank-2 apply) plus the 

3760 eigenvalue-domain Sturm tail. Hermitian input needs only ONE 

3761 reflection per step (vs two for Golub-Kahan), halving the per-step 

3762 cost of the bidiag path. Pure function of the workspace so it can be 

3763 NPUGraph-captured.""" 

3764 kp, rs, block_k = ws["kp"], ws["rs"], ws["block_k"] 

3765 wpitch = ws["wpitch"] 

3766 W, V = ws["W"], ws["V"] 

3767 dbuf, ebuf, taul = ws["dbuf"], ws["ebuf"], ws["taul"] 

3768 nrm2, frob, acc = ws["nrm2"], ws["frob"], ws["acc"] 

3769 apitch = kp + 64 

3770 _fast_launch( 

3771 _mr_rrqr_init_kernel, 

3772 (batch_count, (kp - 64) // 64), 

3773 matrix, 

3774 W, 

3775 nrm2, 

3776 frob, 

3777 m, 

3778 n, 

3779 k, 

3780 rows, 

3781 rs, 

3782 wpitch, 

3783 TALL=True, 

3784 HERMITIAN=True, 

3785 num_warps=4, 

3786 num_stages=1, 

3787 ) 

3788 for j in range(k): 

3789 _fast_launch( 

3790 _mr_tridiag_step_kernel, 

3791 (batch_count,), 

3792 W, 

3793 V, 

3794 dbuf, 

3795 ebuf, 

3796 taul, 

3797 acc, 

3798 frob, 

3799 j, 

3800 k, 

3801 rs, 

3802 wpitch, 

3803 apitch, 

3804 num_warps=4, 

3805 num_stages=1, 

3806 ) 

3807 if j + 1 < k: 

3808 nrt = triton.cdiv(k - 1 - j, 64) 

3809 _fast_launch( 

3810 _mr_tridiag_mat_kernel, 

3811 (batch_count, nrt * nrt), 

3812 W, 

3813 V, 

3814 acc, 

3815 frob, 

3816 j, 

3817 k, 

3818 rs, 

3819 wpitch, 

3820 apitch, 

3821 nrt, 

3822 num_warps=4, 

3823 num_stages=1, 

3824 ) 

3825 _fast_launch( 

3826 _mr_tridiag_apply_kernel, 

3827 (batch_count, nrt * nrt), 

3828 W, 

3829 V, 

3830 taul, 

3831 acc, 

3832 frob, 

3833 j, 

3834 k, 

3835 rs, 

3836 wpitch, 

3837 apitch, 

3838 nrt, 

3839 num_warps=4, 

3840 num_stages=1, 

3841 ) 

3842 _fast_launch( 

3843 _mr_sturm_big_tridiag_kernel, 

3844 (batch_count,), 

3845 dbuf, 

3846 ebuf, 

3847 atol_tensor, 

3848 rtol_tensor, 

3849 ws["out"], 

3850 ws["tol2"], 

3851 ws["flag"], 

3852 k, 

3853 BLOCK=block_k, 

3854 BISECT_ITERS=32, 

3855 num_warps=1, 

3856 num_stages=1, 

3857 ) 

3858 _fast_launch( 

3859 _mr_sturm_final_tridiag_kernel, 

3860 (batch_count,), 

3861 dbuf, 

3862 ebuf, 

3863 ws["tol2"], 

3864 ws["flag"], 

3865 ws["out"], 

3866 k, 

3867 num_warps=1, 

3868 num_stages=1, 

3869 enable_fp_fusion=False, 

3870 ) 

3871 

3872 

3873def _launch_tridiag_big_rank( 

3874 matrix, 

3875 atol_tensor, 

3876 rtol_tensor, 

3877 out, 

3878 m, 

3879 n, 

3880 k, 

3881 rows, 

3882 batch_count, 

3883 input, 

3884): 

3885 """Hermitian k > 64: unblocked one-sided Householder tridiagonalization 

3886 + eigenvalue-domain Sturm count (|lambda| > tol via +/-tol qd chains, 

3887 decisive count in df64). Replaces the Golub-Kahan route for symmetric 

3888 input: half the reflectors per step. NPUGraph-captured per shape (set 

3889 FLAGGEMS_MR_NO_GRAPH=1 to force direct launches).""" 

3890 dev = input.device 

3891 # see _launch_bidiag_rank for why TRITON_ALL_BLOCKS_PARALLEL is popped, 

3892 # and for why the WHOLE body runs under _GRAPH_LOCK (the pop/restore is 

3893 # process-global state; compiles happen inside this body). 

3894 with _GRAPH_LOCK: 

3895 saved_all_blocks = os.environ.pop("TRITON_ALL_BLOCKS_PARALLEL", None) 

3896 try: 

3897 with torch_device_fn.device(input.device): 

3898 if os.environ.get("FLAGGEMS_MR_NO_GRAPH") == "1": 

3899 ws = _tridiag_workspace(dev, batch_count, k, rows) 

3900 _tridiag_run( 

3901 ws, 

3902 matrix, 

3903 atol_tensor, 

3904 rtol_tensor, 

3905 m, 

3906 n, 

3907 k, 

3908 rows, 

3909 batch_count, 

3910 ) 

3911 out.copy_(ws["out"].reshape(out.shape)) 

3912 return out 

3913 key = ( 

3914 m, 

3915 n, 

3916 batch_count, 

3917 input.device.index, 

3918 _current_stream_key(input.device), 

3919 ) 

3920 ent = _TRIDIAG_GRAPHS.get(key) 

3921 if ent is None: 

3922 ws = _tridiag_workspace(dev, batch_count, k, rows) 

3923 staging = torch.empty( 

3924 (batch_count, m, n), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev 

3925 ) 

3926 staging.copy_(matrix) 

3927 ws["atol"].copy_(atol_tensor) 

3928 ws["rtol"].copy_(rtol_tensor) 

3929 _tridiag_run( 

3930 ws, 

3931 staging, 

3932 ws["atol"], 

3933 ws["rtol"], 

3934 m, 

3935 n, 

3936 k, 

3937 rows, 

3938 batch_count, 

3939 ) 

3940 torch.npu.synchronize() 

3941 graph = torch.npu.NPUGraph() 

3942 try: 

3943 with torch.npu.graph(graph): 

3944 _tridiag_run( 

3945 ws, 

3946 staging, 

3947 ws["atol"], 

3948 ws["rtol"], 

3949 m, 

3950 n, 

3951 k, 

3952 rows, 

3953 batch_count, 

3954 ) 

3955 except Exception: 

3956 logger.warning( 

3957 "NPUGraph capture failed for matrix_rank tridiag " 

3958 "shape (%d, %d); falling back to direct launches", 

3959 m, 

3960 n, 

3961 ) 

3962 _tridiag_run( 

3963 ws, 

3964 staging, 

3965 ws["atol"], 

3966 ws["rtol"], 

3967 m, 

3968 n, 

3969 k, 

3970 rows, 

3971 batch_count, 

3972 ) 

3973 out.copy_(ws["out"].reshape(out.shape)) 

3974 return out 

3975 if len(_TRIDIAG_GRAPHS) >= _TRIDIAG_GRAPH_MAX_ENTRIES: 

3976 # An evicted graph may still have an in-flight 

3977 # replay (replay is async); dropping the entry frees 

3978 # its workspace. Rare event (17th distinct shape): 

3979 # drain before freeing. The cache is process-wide 

3980 # and the FIFO victim may live on ANOTHER device, so 

3981 # synchronize the victim's device (key[3]), not the 

3982 # current one. 

3983 victim_key = next(iter(_TRIDIAG_GRAPHS)) 

3984 torch.npu.synchronize(victim_key[3]) 

3985 _TRIDIAG_GRAPHS.pop(victim_key) 

3986 _TRIDIAG_GRAPHS[key] = (ws, staging, graph) 

3987 ws, staging, graph = _TRIDIAG_GRAPHS[key] 

3988 staging.copy_(matrix) 

3989 ws["atol"].copy_(atol_tensor) 

3990 ws["rtol"].copy_(rtol_tensor) 

3991 graph.replay() 

3992 out.copy_(ws["out"].reshape(out.shape)) 

3993 finally: 

3994 if saved_all_blocks is not None: 

3995 os.environ["TRITON_ALL_BLOCKS_PARALLEL"] = saved_all_blocks 

3996 return out
